# SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks

> An on-device bookmarking app for iPhone and iPad. Links saved from any app
> through the share sheet or the clipboard are sorted into topics on the
> device, found again by meaning rather than exact spelling, and brought back
> for review in Rediscover. Saves stay in on-device storage; there is no
> account and no cloud sync.

## Facts
- Saving: iOS share sheet from Threads, Instagram, X, YouTube, Safari or any
  other app; clipboard quick-save when the app is opened.
- Tagging: Apple's NaturalLanguage framework plus a rule-based classifier,
  entirely on device. No cloud service and no generative AI. Tags are editable.
- Search: ranks titles, descriptions, tags and addresses by closeness in
  meaning, on device.
- Rediscover: a short daily review of saves that have not been opened.
- Free: every feature, with the latest 5 saves kept.
- Pro: a one-time purchase, never a subscription. Unlimited saves, custom tags,
  Markdown export and backup, Family Sharing.
- Link previews: when a link is saved, the app requests that page on device,
  directly from the saved site, to read its title and preview details. Nothing
  from SaveTag is attached and the request goes nowhere else.
- Privacy: no account, no cloud sync, no ads, no tracking, no analytics, no
  third-party SDKs, no server operated by the developer.
- Purchases and restores are handled entirely by Apple.
- Home Screen widget and Siri shortcuts read on-device data through Apple's
  app group only.
- Terms of use: a personal, non-transferable licence supplementing Apple's
  standard Licensed Application EULA; Pro is a one-time, non-consumable
  purchase at the price the App Store shows in each country, refunds follow
  Apple's policy, saves are the user's own to back up, the app is provided as
  it is, and Taiwanese law governs. Published at /terms.html in all 50 locales.
- Contact: hourstag.app@gmail.com
